title: opencode
description: opencode 1.19.0 — web UI for AI agent tasks (anomalyco/opencode). Renders to ~/.config/opencode/opencode.json (mode 0600). The `opencode` slot is the single config block; values in this block are written verbatim by the in-VM render-config.sh.

opencode.description: opencode config block. `provider` is a map keyed by provider id (the chosen id from supported_providers.builtin + 'custom'); the chosen provider's options (apiKey, baseURL) are nested under provider.<chosen>.

provider.description: Provider map. Each key is a provider id; the chosen provider's block is the one whose `options.apiKey` is bound to the user's virtual key at deploy time. The form renders this as a 'pick provider + fill options' widget driven by `x-provider-choices` (server-stamped from manifest.configs[].supported_providers).

npm.description: NPM package name for the provider's SDK. Required for `custom` (OpenAI-compatible) providers.

options.description: Provider-specific options. `apiKey` is auto-injected from the user's bound virtual key — leave empty in the form; the deploy service substitutes the real key.

apiKey.description: API key for the provider. Marked `x-secret-source: virtual_key` so the deploy service auto-injects from the bound virtual key — do not paste a real key here.

baseURL.description: Base URL for OpenAI-compatible custom providers (e.g. ollama, vLLM, LiteLLM proxy).

model.description: Primary model id (e.g. 'gpt-4o', 'claude-sonnet-4-5'). Provider-specific; consult your provider's model list.

small_model.description: Smaller / faster model used for lightweight tasks (title generation, summarization, etc.).

default_agent.description: Default agent name (matches an entry under `agent.<name>`).

username.description: Display name shown in the opencode UI.

autoupdate.description: Auto-update behavior. `notify` shows a banner; `true` updates silently; `false` disables.

snapshot.description: Enable session snapshots (allows reverting the workspace state).

subagent_depth.description: Maximum nesting depth for sub-agents. 0 disables sub-agents.

instructions.description: Additional system instructions appended to the default prompt.

disabled_providers.description: Provider ids to hide from the opencode UI.

enabled_providers.description: Provider ids to show in the opencode UI. Empty = all enabled.

permission.description: Tool permission rules. Free-form; consult opencode docs for the schema.

agent.description: Named agent configurations (model + system prompt). Free-form; consult opencode docs for the schema.

shell.description: Shell binary used for command execution (e.g. '/bin/bash').

port.description: TCP port the web server binds to (default 8080).

hostname.description: Bind hostname (default 127.0.0.1). Use 0.0.0.0 to expose on all interfaces.

mdns.description: Advertise the server over mDNS for local discovery.
